title: RadiusCompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize F=f+ψ over convex Q in a real Hilbert space. The function f is convex and continuously differentiable on the whole space; ψ is convex on Q. A minimizer exists.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: The objective includes a possibly nonsmooth convex term ψ and a convex constraint set Q, accessed together through an exact proximal minimization oracle.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: A gradient query at any x returns ∇f(x) exactly, independently of history and oracle seed. No function-value oracle is supplied.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: For every a>0 and z,v, returns an exact minimizer over Q of ‖u−z‖²/(2a)+⟨v,u−z⟩+ψ(u). Gradient and proximal queries share one fixed total call budget.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RadiusCompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: Query.prox; proxObjective; spec.admissible. LongTails/Template.lean: Setup.numOracles; executeWithTrace.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every segment [x,y] on which ‖∇f‖≤M, ‖∇f(x)−∇f(y)‖≤(L0+L1 M)‖x−y‖. Public parameters satisfy L0>0 and L1≥0; no global Lipschitz gradient bound is required.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Public x0∈Q and R>0 satisfy ‖x0−x★‖≤R for some composite minimizer with ‖∇f(x★)‖≤G. The parameter G≥0 is hidden from the algorithm, although the budget depends on it. No initial objective-gap bound or bounded feasible set is assumed. The ambient real Hilbert space may be infinite-dimensional.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RadiusCompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: Public; Params.G; spec.publicInput; spec.valid; spec.admissible. LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.makeAlgorithm.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: For ε>0, the output satisfies F(output)−F(x★)≤ε relative to a minimizer x★∈Q.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The returned point must belong to Q.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: Feasibility and the objective-gap bound hold almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Convex composite optimization with gradient-dependent smoothness, a radius-only initialization guarantee, and a hidden gradient bound at a composite minimizer is a meaningful variant of the classical globally smooth formulation.

descriptionHtml:
Radius-Constrained Composite Convex Minimization

We minimize F=f+ψ over a convex set Q in a real Hilbert space E, where f:E→R is differentiable and convex and ψ:E→R is convex on Q. The function f is (L0,L1)-smooth, with L0>0 and L1≥0. A given x0∈Q satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R and ∥∇f(x⋆)∥≤G for some minimizer x⋆, where R>0 and G≥0. The oracle returns exact gradients and constrained proximal minimizers. For ε>0, the goal is a feasible output x¯∈Q with F(x¯)−F(x⋆)≤ε almost surely under P, the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

Writing F(x)=f(x)+ψ(x), the optimization problem is minx∈QF(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ on E. The algorithm receives E, L0, L1, R, ε, and x0; the bound G may enter only the oracle-call budget.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity). The set Q⊆E is convex. For every t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y),x,y∈E,ψ((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)ψ(x)+tψ(y),x,y∈Q.

Assumption 2 (Generalized smoothness). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere on E, and ∇f:E→E is continuous. For every x,y∈E and M∈R, ∥∇f(x+θ(y−x))∥≤Mfor all θ∈[0,1]⟹∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤(L0+L1M)∥x−y∥.

Assumption 3 (Exact proximal minimization). There is a map T:R×E×E→E such that, for every a>0 and z,v∈E, T(a,z,v)∈argminu∈Q{∥u−z∥22a+⟨v,u−z⟩+ψ(u)}.

Assumption 4 (Initial distance and minimizer gradient). The given starting point satisfies x0∈Q. There exists x⋆∈Q such that F(x⋆)≤F(x)for every x∈Q,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,∥∇f(x⋆)∥≤G.

The oracle returns ∇f(x) at x. It also returns T(a,z,v) on a proximal query (a,z,v). Gradient queries may use any x∈E, and proximal queries may use any a∈R and z,v∈E; the proximal minimization requirement applies only for a>0. Both query types count toward a single total oracle-call budget.

After the allotted calls, the output must satisfy x¯∈Q,F(x¯)−F(x⋆)≤εP-a.s. Here P is the law of the algorithm’s randomness, and x⋆ is a fixed minimizer independent of that randomness.

comparisonHtml:
Minimize F=f+ψ over convex Q in a real Hilbert space. The function f is convex and continuously differentiable on the whole space, with ∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤(L0+L1supz∈[x,y]∥∇f(z)∥)∥x−y∥; ψ is convex on Q. Exact gradients and an exact joint prox of ψ+ιQ are available. Here L0,R,ε>0, L1,G≥0, x0∈Q, and some minimizer x⋆∈Q satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R and ∥∇f(x⋆)∥≤G. Target: feasible x with F(x)−F(x⋆)≤ε, deterministically.

Sufficient oracle budgets for RadiusCompositeGeneralizedSmooth.
Result Oracle complexity Novelty Limitations
(1) RadiusCompositeAccelerated (Ours) (⋆⋆⋆) (review) O(((1+a)4/3+T)ℓ2) gradient and joint-prox calls, including initialization and rejected trials.
(2) AGLS (Deng and Gao 2026), Thm. 6.1, Prop. 6.2. O(1+ea/2T+log+⁡(L⋆/Linit)) gradient, prox and value calls; worst-ball substitution upper bound. Applies in Rd with closed ψ+ιQ. (1): polynomial dependence on a replaces the exponential substitution bound; no function values. For a≤1, matches the accuracy term up to ℓ2. (1) needs L0,L1,R,ε in updates and G for stopping. (2) allows general continuous local curvature.
(3) Derived bound (LongTails 2026): prox initialization and gap certificate. O(T+(1+a)(1+a+log⁡(1+L1G/L0))) gradient and prox calls, conditional on the initialized certificate Δ≲(L0+L1G)eO(a)R2. (1): gain when a≫1 and Tℓ2≪a2. At T=a2, log⁡(1+L1G/L0)=O(a): O(a4/3log2⁡a) instead of O(a2). (1) adds ℓ2 to the T term.
(4) Gap-based acceleration (LongTails 2026). O(1+T+(1+a)⋅log(2+(1+a)ΔL0R2)) gradient and prox calls; supplied Δ≥F(x0)−F(x⋆). (1): no initial objective-gap bound is needed. Small known Δ can make (4) cheaper; (1) adds ℓ2 to the T term.
(5) (Rudomanov et al. 2026), Thm. 3.7. O(L0R2/ε+(1+a)log⁡(2+a)) gradient calls. Special case: E=Rd, Q=E, ψ=0, G=0; L1>0. (1): scope extends to constrained composite objectives and minimizers with nonzero smooth-part gradient. On the overlap, (1) has a4/3 rather than a transient dependence, with additional logarithmic factors; its prox becomes a closed-form update.

Abbr: a=L1R, T=(L0+L1G)R2/ε, ℓ=log⁡(2+a+T); Δ is an initial gap bound at the indicated starting point; ιQ is the convex indicator of Q. In (2), L⋆=2supx,y∈BR(x⋆)L(x,y)≲(L0+L1G)ea, where L is the local gradient Lipschitz coefficient; Linit>0 is the initial line-search estimate; log+⁡t=max{0,log⁡t}. Each primitive gradient, prox or value evaluation counts as one call; all budgets are sufficient upper bounds.

import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Function
import LongTails.Template

open Set
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.RadiusCompositeGeneralizedSmooth

open OracleTemplate

structure Public where
  E : Type u
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  L0 : ℝ
  L1 : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Public.normedE Public.linearE Public.completeE

structure Params extends Public where
  G : ℝ

inductive Query (p : Public) where
  | gradient (x : p.E)
  | prox (a : ℝ) (z v : p.E)

structure Instance (p : Public) where
  f : p.E → ℝ
  ψ : p.E → ℝ
  Q : Set p.E
  grad : p.E → p.E
  prox : ℝ → p.E → p.E → p.E

noncomputable def objective {p : Public} (I : Instance p) (x : p.E) : ℝ := I.f x + I.ψ x

noncomputable def proxObjective {p : Public} (I : Instance p) (a : ℝ) (z v u : p.E) : ℝ :=
  ‖u - z‖ ^ 2 / (2 * a) + ⟪v, u - z⟫ + I.ψ u

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Public
  Instance := Instance
  Query := Query
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput := Params.toPublic
  valid q := 0 < q.L0 ∧ 0 ≤ q.L1 ∧ 0 < q.R ∧ 0 < q.ε ∧ 0 ≤ q.G
  admissible q I oracle :=
    (∀ k seed x, oracle.answer k (0, .gradient x) seed = I.grad x) ∧
    (∀ k seed a z v, oracle.answer k (0, .prox a z v) seed = I.prox a z v) ∧
    ConvexOn ℝ univ I.f ∧
    (∀ x, HasGradientAt I.f (I.grad x) x) ∧
    Continuous I.grad ∧
    (∀ x y M, (∀ θ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖I.grad (x + θ • (y - x))‖ ≤ M) →
      ‖I.grad x - I.grad y‖ ≤ (q.L0 + q.L1 * M) * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    Convex ℝ I.Q ∧
    ConvexOn ℝ I.Q I.ψ ∧
    (∀ a, 0 < a → ∀ z v, I.prox a z v ∈ I.Q ∧
      IsMinOn (proxObjective I a z v) I.Q (I.prox a z v)) ∧
    q.x0 ∈ I.Q ∧
    (∃ xstar ∈ I.Q, IsMinOn (objective I) I.Q xstar ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R ∧
      ‖I.grad xstar‖ ≤ q.G)
  successful q I output P :=
    ∃ xstar ∈ I.Q, IsMinOn (objective I) I.Q xstar ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : MeasureTheory.Measure _),
        output ω ∈ I.Q ∧ objective I (output ω) - objective I xstar ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.RadiusCompositeGeneralizedSmooth
